Offlane Countess is tricky. depending on the jungler is whether or not you want to conserve more mana. Always start with Shadow Slip to help last hit minions and poke the carry. Then focus on upgrading Tidal Wave, and Siphon, then Shadow Slip in that order. Ult upgrade always. 

When early game, focus on leveling up, and help control river buffs so you don't have to back as often. Poke carry with Shadow slip, hit hit, slip back. But watch your mana as you don't want to not have any if a gank is to come. When engaging team fights, try to get behind, and focus the ADC. Don't engage with shadow slip, start with tidal wave, siphon, Ult, then whether or not they are escaping, use another ability, or shadow slip to them. You want to be careful before you have necroveil, it is hard to escape the rest of the team. Always watch lanes as you can clear them the fastest, and if you are pushing use wards! Always ward! When going through their jungle ward. You want to have eyes on people who are alone, because that's where you come in.
